Language is already independently bound by the sanitized runtime-admission source suffix and canonical seed anchor declaration; this is an adapter interface defect, not a scientific observation.

Two receipts, Q026 and Q045, are COMPLETE while still containing a ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE guard plus unavailable coordinate slots. More generally, transport eligibility must be evaluated from the required anchor and slot conditions themselves before contract projection. Throwing an exception prevents a complete fail-closed row from being emitted.
